whyApproximatelySixty: The management directory unions every identity that appears in ANY of several discovery sources, not only ACTIVE members. In practice that merges (1) signed membership tips (ACTIVE/REMOVED/BLOCKED/CONFLICT), (2) control blocklist pubkeys, (3) SOS email-registry authors (kind 37377), (4) SOS-tagged kind:0 profile authors, and (5) last-activity enrichment from kind:1 notes for already-known keys. Profile-only and registry-only identities that never became operational members still appear under LEGACY. Historical REMOVED/BLOCKED tips remain visible. Relays return up to KNOWN_USERS_MAX per query, so a busy israel-network easily reaches ~50–70 distinct pubkeys even when ACTIVE membership is much smaller.

sources.description: Canonical membership rows from MembershipState / directory('') — ACTIVE, REMOVED, BLOCKED, CONFLICT, ROOT
blockedPubkeys on verified group-control tip (may include non-members)
Own SOS email-registry events tagged email-registry + israel-network
Verified kind:0 profiles tagged israel-network (profile-only identities)
Kind:1 notes used only to stamp lastActiveAt for already-known keys (does not add new keys)
ACCOUNT_DISABLED / ENABLED tips (new). Disabled identities remain searchable in admin filters but leave the operational default list.
DIRECTORY_HIDDEN / VISIBLE tips (new). Hide is list hygiene, not cryptographic deletion.
